description: The agent must: (1) Create `packages/lobster-epigenomics/` with correct PEP 420 namespace structure — crucially NO `lobster/__init__.py` inside the package. (2) Define `AGENT_CONFIG = AgentRegistryConfig(...)` at the very TOP of the agent file, before any heavy imports, to satisfy the <50ms entry-point discovery requirement. (3) Set `tier_requirement='free'` in AGENT_CONFIG. (4) Implement the factory function with `delegation_tools` parameter (NOT the deprecated `handoff_tools`), plus `data_manager`, `callback_handler`, `workspace_path`. (5) Create a service class with an `analyze` method returning a strict 3-tuple `(AnnData, Dict, AnalysisStep)`. (6) Call `data_manager.log_tool_usage(...)` with `ir=ir` keyword argument inside the tool wrapper. (7) Write `test_contract.py` using `AgentContractTestMixin` with `agent_module` and `factory_name` class attributes pointing to the new agent. (8) Register the agent in `pyproject.toml` under `[project.entry-points."lobster.agents"]` and set `[tool.setuptools] packages.find = {where=["."], include=["lobster*"], namespaces=true}` for the namespace package merge.
